Telegram works fundamentally differently: Parameter Instagram / VK Telegram Message deliverability 5–15% up to 100% Algorithmic feed Yes (cuts reach) No Active audience (2026) ~2 bln / ~100 mln 900+ mln Mass messaging capability Limited Full Average open rate 15–25% 40–80% Cost of reach High (paid targeted ads) Low Key advantages of Telegram for business: Direct access to the audience. No algorithms hiding your posts. High engagement. The open rate on Telegram is 3–4 times higher than that of email newsletters. Rich functionality. Bots, channels, groups, mini-apps, built-in payments — all in one ecosystem. Scalability. Automation allows you to reach thousands of potential customers without expanding your staff. Response speed. A message on Telegram is read on average within 3–5 minutes after being sent. 3 key strategies for Telegram marketing automation Effective Telegram marketing is built on three stages of the funnel: acquisition → conversion → retention . Let's break down each one. 1. Customer acquisition: inviting and parsing The first task is to find your target audience and bring them to your channel or group. Three mechanics work here: Parsing audience from competitor chats The system analyzes active participants in competitor chats and related communities, forming a database of potential clients. You get an audience that is already interested in your topic — this is radically different from cold targeting. Inviting to your group or channel The collected database is automatically invited to your community. This is a targeted invitation of a niche audience that is potentially interested in your product. Geo-parsing for local businesses A particularly valuable tool for cafes, beauty salons, fitness clubs, and other offline businesses. The system finds users by geographical location — those who live or work near your location. 💡 Tip: Combine topical parsing + geo-parsing for maximum accuracy in hitting your target audience. 2. Conversion: mass messaging and neuro-commenting Bringing in an audience is only half the battle. It is important to convert interest into a purchase. Personalized mass messaging in DMs Mass messaging with addressing by name shows a conversion rate 2–3 times higher than impersonal messages. Modern tools allow you to: Set up templates with dynamic variables (name, city, interest) Segment the database by parameters Conduct A/B testing of texts and offers Track delivery and responses in real-time via analytics Neuro-commenting based on AI (GPT) One of the most underestimated tools. The system automatically leaves live, contextually relevant comments based on the content of posts in your niche channels. Result: Increased brand awareness Organic traffic to your channel Building a reputation as an expert in the niche ⚠️ Important: Unlike template spam, GPT comments bring real value to readers and organically fit into the discussion — making the method highly effective in the long run. 3. Customer retention: auto-funnels A new subscriber is not yet a customer. An automated funnel turns them into a buyer without a manager's involvement: Step 1: Welcome message → immediately after subscription ↓Step 2: Series of useful content → 2–5 days ↓Step 3: Offer — product or service proposal ↓Step 4: Follow-up for those who didn't respond → after 24–48 hours ↓Step 5: Final reminder / special offer Why it works: a person who has just subscribed is at the peak of their interest. The auto-funnel "catches" this moment and leads them to a purchase through a proven scenario — 24/7, without employee involvement. What is audience parsing in Telegram? Parsing is the automated collection of data about participants in Telegram chats and channels. Deskgram 2 analyzes publicly available profiles of thematic community members and forms a database for subsequent inviting or mass messaging. How does neuro-commenting differ from spam? Neuro-commenting uses GPT to generate meaningful, contextually relevant comments based on the post's content. Unlike template spam, such comments carry value for readers and organically fit into the discussion. Is it safe to use Deskgram 2? Yes.
